notes: The whole D14 site is one model. It is a raised gravel pad about 144 x 77 m (scale bar about 5.1 px/m) with 4.5 m earth slopes and a front access ramp. On it: a derrick about 60 m tall on a 14.5 m substructure, a gen house with stack, three containers, an office trailer with awning, a tank bund with two tanks, pipe racks, a comms mast and a floodlight. Layout follows the Top and Front views. Taken at face value, the scale bar makes the equipment oversized (containers about 7 x 16.7 x 6 m), but I followed it. The two side views don't match the plan: the pad is drawn as wide as in the front view and the derrick is shifted forward. Trailer and mast x positions differ by a few metres between views, so expect weaker registration on the sides.
